title.narrative: Southern Africa Migration Management (SAMM) Project

description.narrative: The overall objective of this programme is to improve migration management in the Southern Africa and Indian Ocean region. It is alligned with the 11th EDF RIP for EA, SA and IO, that includes among its objectives the facilitation of legal migration and the prevention of irregular migration. The action focuses on South-South migration flows in a comprehensive manner, taking into account the development-security-migration nexus, and also identifying positive spill-over effects of migration on regional integration and regional economic development. Four United Nations Agencies (ILO, IOM, UNODC and UNHCR) will implement the Action. The following two specific objectives are envisaged: SO1: To improve options for legal labour mobility in the Southern Africa/Indian Ocean region and strengthen migrant workers' protection from abuse (in the context of intra- and inter-regional labour migration). SO2: To strengthen informed decision-making on and management of mixed migration flows, including improved protection of vulnerable migrants in the Southern African and Indian Ocean region.
